Report reports/phase19/h19b_bag5_f4.json
H19-B.sub_eval_identity_fix: eval assertion relaxed from abs<1e-9 to relative<1e-9 (float64 rank-sum vs exact-credit paths differ ~3e-13 relative at 4.83e9 pairs); an internal sanity check, not a decision threshold

H19-FM-SCREEN.detail: fold-0 discovery screen of installable tabular foundation models on the champion raw-21+coarse10 view, 20k stratified fold-0-safe context, 50k fold-0 eval rows: Causilo port_delta -1.01e-3 (AUC 0.9567, corr 0.986), TabICL-v2 -1.40e-3 (AUC 0.9563, corr 0.984), xRFM -9.29e-3 (AUC 0.9306, corr 0.824); TabDPT FAILED (cuda kernel unavailable), TabFM deferred (needs jax backend). All ran models are far below the +5e-5 promising bar. Inference-only (light GPU) + HF checkpoint downloads (~GB). Report reports/phase19/foundation_screen/summary_fmscreen_fold0_ctx20k_e50k.json

rationale_gpu_zero: The top-3 ranked hypotheses (H19-A reweighted member, H19-B deployment pseudo-test, H19-C smoothed key) are all CPU LightGBM experiments. H19-E (neural) is a reserve with a strong negative prior (~1e-3 below champion) and is not worth GPU spend. The 12h GPU ceiling is held in reserve should a concrete neural or TabPFN-side hypothesis emerge that plausibly closes a 1e-3 gap; none currently does.
